scope: The control family diag(1,...,1,1-t) on C-infinity(R)^91 to C-infinity(R)^70; it is not a source-owned K77 transverse family.

preflight_bookend.route_comparison: Compute the quotient by Hadamard division before calling the fiber rank jump a new relation or physical cohomology class.
preflight_bookend.retrieval_collision_result: K425 records a fiber kernel and cokernel jump but deliberately does not compute the global smooth module.

smooth_result.global_kernel: C-infinity(R)^21 from the final 21 zero columns
smooth_result.range: target vectors whose final component vanishes at t=1
smooth_result.hadamard_division: f(1)=0 iff f=(1-t)g for a smooth g
smooth_result.cokernel: R via evaluation of the final component at t=1

decision.next_exact_input: A source/action-owned transverse coefficient family and its actual smooth section/domain category before interpreting any local cokernel as BV/BFV cohomology.

postflight_bookend.strongest_overclaim: Calling the evaluation class a physical state, boundary charge or source-owned cohomology class.
postflight_bookend.strongest_contrary_construction: In the L2 completion the same multiplier has dense range and zero reduced cokernel, so the smooth class is not category-independent.
postflight_bookend.weakest_reproducibility_seam: Hadamard division is exact; the coefficient family and smooth category remain control choices rather than K77-owned data.

claim_ceiling: Exact smooth-category theorem for the control family with final coefficient 1-t. The global smooth kernel remains the original 21 free columns; the extra fiber kernel at t=1 does not globalize to a smooth syzygy. Evaluation at t=1 identifies a one-dimensional cokernel. This is category-dependent control cohomology, not source-owned K77 data, physical BV/BFV cohomology, a Green domain, an observation map or a source/ledger/canon/public verdict.
